# Buy a Business India

> The independent resource for Indian entrepreneurs, NRIs, and first-time buyers
> acquiring small businesses in India. Non-commercial, no affiliates, no advertising.

## Core Guides

- [How to Buy a Business in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/guide/how-to-buy): Step-by-step guide from finding deals to closing, covering search, valuation, due diligence, negotiation, and transfer.
- [How to Value a Small Business in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/guide/valuation): Valuation methods used in the Indian market, including earnings multiples (2-4x), asset-based valuation, and market comparisons.
- [Due Diligence Checklist](https://buyabusiness-india.com/guide/due-diligence): Complete due diligence framework for Indian SMB acquisitions covering financials, legal, operations, and GST compliance.

## Blog Articles

- [How to Value a Small Business in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/how-to-value-small-business-india): Practical guide to earnings multiples, SDE, and asset-based valuation for Indian businesses.
- [Due Diligence Checklist for Indian Business Acquisition](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/due-diligence-checklist-india): Full checklist covering financial, legal, operational, and tax due diligence specific to India.
- [How to Negotiate a Business Price in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/negotiate-business-price-india): Negotiation tactics, LOI structure, and deal terms for Indian SMB acquisitions.
- [Off-Market Deals in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/off-market-deals-india): How 80% of Indian business sales happen off-market and how to find them.
- [SMERGERS vs IndiaBizForSale](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/smergers-vs-indiabizforsale): Independent comparison of India's two primary business-for-sale marketplaces.
- [Seller Financing in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/seller-financing-india): How seller financing works in Indian acquisitions and how to negotiate it.
- [Real Cost of Buying a Business in India](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/real-cost-buying-business-india): Beyond the purchase price — legal fees, due diligence costs, working capital, and transition costs.
- [Businesses for Sale Under 25 Lakhs in Mumbai](https://buyabusiness-india.com/blog/businesses-under-25-lakhs-mumbai): Market overview of sub-₹25L acquisition opportunities in Mumbai.

## About

- [About](https://buyabusiness-india.com/about): Independent educational site. No advertising, no affiliate commissions, no brokerage relationships. Content created by people with direct acquisition experience in India.

## Key Facts

- India has over 63 million SMBs but fewer than 20 PE firms focused on small business acquisitions
- Typical profit multiples in India: 2-4x (vs 4-6x in the US)
- Common deal sizes: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
- Typical acquisition timeline: 4-9 months
- NRIs can acquire businesses under RBI automatic route for most sectors
